footer.tagline: Professional car detailing services that restore and protect your vehicle's appearance with premium care and attention to detail.

services.subtitle: Professional car detailing packages tailored to restore, protect, and enhance your vehicle.

basicWash.title: Basic Wash
basicWash.description: Quick and efficient refresh for both exterior and interior with light protection.
features: Contactless pre-wash & hand wash using safe techniques
Protective wax layer for enhanced water repellency
Thorough tire cleaning and professional dressing
Crystal-clear, streak-free glass finish
Quick interior vacuuming and surface wipe-down

fullDetail.title: Full Exterior & Interior Detail
fullDetail.description: Comprehensive inside-and-out detail that restores your car’s appearance and adds lasting protection.
features: Contactless pre-wash & hand wash
Paint surface decontamination (removes tar, sap, and bonded contaminants)
Wheel & tire detailing (deep clean + tire dressing)
Interior deep cleaning (vacuuming, carpets, seats, vents, trims)
Door jambs and trunk crevices thoroughly cleaned
Crystal-clear, streak-free glass finish (inside & out)
Plastic trim conditioning & UV protection
Leather cleaning & conditioning

ceramicCoating.title: Ceramic Coating Package
ceramicCoating.description: Full Exterior & Interior Detail plus ceramic coating for durable shine and protection.
features: All services from Full Exterior & Interior Detail
Advanced ceramic coating applied to all painted surfaces
Exceptional hydrophobic effect – water beads and sheets off effortlessly, making washing faster and easier
Deep, mirror-like gloss with enhanced color depth and clarity
Long-lasting protection, typically 4 weeks up to 4 months depending on maintenance and driving conditions
Cleaning and maintenance of exterior rubber and plastic surfaces

paintCorrection.title: Paint Correction Package
paintCorrection.description: Professional-grade correction and coating for a showroom-quality finish.
features: All services from Full Exterior & Interior Detail
Full decontamination including clay bar treatment
Multi-stage paint correction (removes swirls, oxidation, light scratches)
Ceramic coating for lasting gloss and protection
Enhanced paint clarity and depth

ultimateDetail.title: Ultimate Detailing Package
ultimateDetail.description: Our top-tier, bespoke detailing service designed for perfection without compromise.
features: Tailored full exterior & interior transformation
Custom paint correction and protection plan
Premium coatings for maximum durability
Comprehensive care to meet your car’s unique needs
